mia.known_private_basis: Exact unique self-challenge QI matches plus contest private-block design

v4.selection_basis: Route only releases whose public QI/outcome association is below the shadow-separated AUC threshold. The validated v3 membership selection is held exactly fixed and only active times are replaced.

v3.selection_basis: Leaderboard aggregates do not separate target-wise selection and time-link errors, so the validated v2 AIA is retained.

independent.algorithm: public outcome-integrity router over reusable multiview residual and horizon codebook experts

aia.complement: v7 complement of three active sets, edge time 9.5; two fixed routed experts
